name: Hellbreaker makes Unleash Pestilence remove movement impairing effects (#1314)
contract: Hellbreaker 680216 reads 'Casting Unleash Pestilence now removes all active movement impairing effects from you' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp's OnSpellCast handler for SPELL_UNLEASH_PESTILENCE (801002) now calls player->RemoveMovementImpairingAuras(true) when the caster has aura 680216, before Unleash() itself runs - the same native Unit method other classes use for on-cast cleanses (e.g. AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp, AscensionPyromancer.cpp).
